risks.title: Cyclicality of the paper industry
risks.score_rationale: The paper and pulp industry is cyclical with price and volume fluctuations linked to macroeconomic conditions. Challenging conditions in 2025 reduced uncoated paper volumes across all three regions. This is mentioned in the 10-K, section Item 1A and Item 1, and is considered a significant risk due to its impact on sales and profitability.

risks.title: Inflation and rising costs
risks.score_rationale: Inflation has increased operating and material costs (wood fiber, chemicals, transportation, energy). In 2025, input costs and operations were unfavorable across all three regions. This is mentioned in the 10-K, section Item 1A, and is considered a significant risk due to its impact on profitability.

risks.title: Competition and pricing pressure
risks.score_rationale: The company operates in a highly competitive environment with commoditized products. Competition is primarily price-based. In 2025, pricing and mix were unfavorable in Europe and Latin America. This is mentioned in the 10-K, section Item 1A, and is considered a significant risk.

risks.title: Secular decline in paper demand
risks.score_rationale: Demand for paper products is in long-term structural decline due to increasing adoption of digital media and alternative materials. This is mentioned in the 10-K, section Item 1, and represents a major strategic risk to the long-term viability of operations.

risks.title: Climate and environmental risks
risks.score_rationale: Extreme climate events could disrupt operations, supply chains, and increase costs. In 2025, losses from wildfires in Brazil affected operations. This is mentioned in the 10-K, section Item 1A, and is considered a significant risk.

risks.title: Geopolitical and trade risks
risks.score_rationale: Geopolitical events, trade conflicts, and restrictions could disrupt global operations and supply chains. Sylvamo operates across three major regions with significant reliance on international markets. This is mentioned in the 10-K, section Item 1A.

risks.title: Public health crisis
risks.score_rationale: A public health crisis could reduce paper demand (school closures, remote work) and disrupt operations. This is mentioned in the 10-K, section Item 1 Business, and is considered a significant risk due to its potential impact.

risks.title: Environmental regulatory risks
risks.score_rationale: Evolving environmental regulations could increase compliance and operating costs. This is mentioned in the 10-K, section Item 1, and represents a significant risk due to its potential impact on profitability.
